description: This file is a PHP source code for an OpenCart admin controller class responsible for handling dashboard order management, including displaying order stats and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard order statistics and configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the order dashboard with statistics, breadcrumbs, and configuration form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of dashboard settings via POST request, returning JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the dashboard data including order statistics and layout elements.
